## 1 Data Preparation 

```{r}
# Set the working directory to the Downloads folder
setwd("~/Downloads")

# Check the working directory
getwd()

# Check the files available in the Downloads folder
#list.files()

# Load the data
counts <- read.csv("counts (1).csv", check.names = FALSE)

names(counts)[1] <- "gene_id"
meta_data <- read.csv("meta_data (1).csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Inspect the data
dim(counts)
dim(meta_data)

names(counts)[1:5]
names(meta_data)

#head(counts[, 1:5])
#head(meta_data)

```
# 2)Gene Selection and Summary Statistics

```{r}
## Inspecting the Data

## Selected Genes: ESR1 and ERBB2 

#ESR1 was selected as the primary gene for this analysis because it is an important gene involved in estrogen receptor biology and breast cancer.

# Give the first column a consistent name
names(counts)[1] <- "gene_id"

# Find ESR1 by its Ensembl ID
esr1_row <- counts[
  counts$gene_id == "ENSG00000091831.24",
]

# Check the result
#nrow(esr1_row)

#esr1_counts <- as.numeric(esr1_row[1, -1])

# Check the first few values
#head(esr1_counts)

# Identify the ESR1 and ERBB2 rows
esr1_row <- counts[
  counts$gene_id == "ENSG00000091831.24", ]

erbb2_row <- counts[
  counts$gene_id == "ENSG00000141736.14", ]

# Extract expression counts across all samples
esr1_counts <- as.numeric(esr1_row[1, -1])
erbb2_counts <- as.numeric(erbb2_row[1, -1])

# Calculate summary statistics for each gene
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Gene = c("ESR1", "ERBB2"),
  Mean = c(mean(esr1_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean(erbb2_counts, na.rm = TRUE)),
  Median = c(median(esr1_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
             median(erbb2_counts, na.rm = TRUE)),
  SD = c(sd(esr1_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
         sd(erbb2_counts, na.rm = TRUE)),
  Minimum = c(min(esr1_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
              min(erbb2_counts, na.rm = TRUE)),
  Maximum = c(max(esr1_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(erbb2_counts, na.rm = TRUE))
)

# Round values for presentation
summary_stats[-1] <- lapply(
  summary_stats[-1],
  round,
  digits = 2
)

# Display the table
knitr::kable(
  summary_stats,
  caption = "Summary Statistics for ESR1 and ERBB2 Gene Expression"
)

table_grob <- tableGrob(
  summary_stats,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 14)
)

png(
  filename = "~/Downloads/summary_statistics.png",
  width = 1800,
  height = 700,
  res = 200
)

grid.draw(table_grob)
dev.off()


```
# Visualizations 
#A) ESR1 Expression Histogram

```{r}
# Create a data frame for ESR1 expression
esr1_df <- data.frame(ESR1 = esr1_counts)

# Create the updated histogram
ggplot(esr1_df, aes(x = ESR1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of ESR1 Gene Expression",
    x = "ESR1 Expression Counts",
    y = "Number of Samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("esr1_histogram.png",
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


#B) Scatter plot — ESR1 vs. ERBB2

```{r}
# Check the actual name of the first column
names(counts)[1]

# Look at the first few gene IDs
head(counts[[1]])

# Extract the ERBB2 gene row
erbb2_row <- counts[
  counts[[1]] == "ENSG00000141736.14",
]

nrow(erbb2_row)

erbb2_counts <- as.numeric(erbb2_row[1, -1])

## B) ESR1 and ERBB2 Scatter Plot

# Create a data frame for the scatter plot
esr1_erbb2_df <- data.frame(
  ESR1 = esr1_counts,
  ERBB2 = erbb2_counts
)

# Plot ESR1 versus ERBB2 expression
ggplot(esr1_erbb2_df, aes(x = ESR1, y = ERBB2)) +
  geom_point(color = "hotpink3",alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "ESR1 and ERBB2 Gene Expression",
    x = "ESR1 Expression Counts",
    y = "ERBB2 Expression Counts"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("esr1_erbb2_scatter.png",
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

#C) Box Plot


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Extract ESR1 gene expression
esr1_row <- counts[counts$gene_id == "ENSG00000091831.24", ]

esr1_counts <- as.numeric(esr1_row[1, -1])

# Combine expression data with subtype information
esr1_subtype_df <- data.frame(
  ESR1 = esr1_counts,
  PAM50 = meta_data$paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50
)

esr1_subtype_df <- esr1_subtype_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PAM50))

# Create box plot
ggplot(esr1_subtype_df, aes(x = PAM50, y = ESR1, fill = PAM50)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PAM50), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "LumA" = "#E78AC3",
    "LumB" = "#8DA0CB",
    "Basal" = "#FC8D62",
    "Her2" = "#66C2A5",
    "Normal" = "#FFD92F"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "LumA" = "#C44E91",
    "LumB" = "#536DA6",
    "Basal" = "#D95F02",
    "Her2" = "#238B72",
    "Normal" = "#B39B00"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "ESR1 Expression Across PAM50 Breast Cancer Subtypes",
    x = "PAM50 Molecular Subtype",
    y = "ESR1 Expression Counts"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("esr1_pam50_boxplot.png",
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```


#4)Heatmap Analysis

```{r}

# Load the heatmap package
library(pheatmap)

# Create the gene expression matrix from the count data
gene_matrix <- as.matrix(counts[, -1])
rownames(gene_matrix) <- counts$gene_id

# Select the 10 most variable genes
gene_variances <- apply(gene_matrix, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
top_genes <- names(sort(gene_variances, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]

# Get the sample IDs from the gene expression matrix
sample_ids <- colnames(gene_matrix)

# Match sample IDs to metadata barcodes
metadata_rows <- match(sample_ids, meta_data$barcode)

# Keep samples with matching metadata and known PAM50 subtypes
keep <- !is.na(metadata_rows)

keep[keep] <- !is.na(
  meta_data$paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50[metadata_rows[keep]]
)

# Select the top genes and samples with known subtypes
heatmap_matrix <- log2(
  gene_matrix[top_genes, keep, drop = FALSE] + 1
)

# Create the PAM50 annotation data frame
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  PAM50 = meta_data$paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50[metadata_rows[keep]]
)

# Align annotation rows with the heatmap columns
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_matrix)

# Draw the heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Gene Expression Across PAM50 Subtypes"
)

ggsave("heatmap.png",
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
#5) Bar Chart

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

pam50_counts <- meta_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50)) %>%
  count(paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50)

ggplot(
  pam50_counts,
  aes(x = paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50,
      y = n,
      fill = paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50)
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PAM50 Molecular Subtypes",
    x = "PAM50 Molecular Subtype",
    y = "Number of Samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("pam50_subtype_barplot.png",
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
